title: Set per-user budgets on AI Gateway
summary: You can now use AI Gateway budgets to set a dollar spending limit for each user on your team. The limit covers spend from every API key attributed to the user, along with their app tokens. After it's reached, AI Gateway rejects new requests until the budget resets or is increased. title: Vercel Sandbox now calculates snapshot storage costs daily
summary: Vercel now calculates charges for Sandbox snapshot storage from each day’s average usage and adds them to your monthly invoice. Previously, billing used one average across the entire monthly billing period. You can track these daily charges on the team’s Usage page and see how changes in storage affect your cost.
